# Phase 0 Part 7: Include every mobile fixture in the release evidence contract

The earlier submission ran all 39 portable mobile tests successfully but declared
only 37 in its evidence checklist. Its strict release gates correctly rejected
the mismatch. This submission includes the two conflict-safe Discard tests and
rejects any future mismatch between discovered fixtures and the declared contract.
Release gates remain required before publishing assets.

The source also includes Phase 1 Parts 1–3 (independent bounded private session
owners, native mixed-session checks and memory-pressure cleanup), plus Phase 2
Parts 1–2 (conflict-safe repeatable one-way folder pulls and private import identity).
The Phase 1 native suite passes all 19 cases locally on iOS and Android. Remaining
Files presentation, reader refinements and independent windows are unfinished.

A separate PySide6 6.12 iOS proof reuses the actual commonUtils browser with two
tabs, highlighted editor, Markdown reader and compiled rclone bridge. All four
programmatic checks pass on phone and tablet simulators; 71 shared regression
tests pass. Its column view is explicitly omitted, its generated build targets
iOS 18, and it does not replace the Toga app or establish production readiness.

Physical provider permissions, older OS compatibility, real fold gestures,
accessibility combinations and BOOX/E Ink behavior remain device validation limits.
